rules.label: File format
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements" (Seller Central help, publicly readable, checked 2026-09-18): "We accept assets in .GLB and .glTF file formats" — GLB is the recommended format.

rules.label: Khronos glTF-Validator errors
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "The Khronos Group glTF-Validator tool must be used to check that files meet technical requirements." This check runs that exact validator.

rules.label: Maximum triangle count
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "Models should not exceed 200K triangles."

rules.label: Maximum texture resolution
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": textures must be "no larger than 4K (4,096 x 4,096 pixels)".

rules.label: Minimum texture resolution
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "Texture resolution should not be less than 2K (2048 px x 2048 px)".

rules.label: Square, power-of-two textures
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": each texture "must be square and power of two".

rules.label: Texture image format
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "We accept texture files in .PNG and .JPG format. We do not accept glTF files with image resources embedded directly in JSON."

rules.label: Required PBR texture maps
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": all materials are PBR metal-rough; BaseColor, Metallic and Roughness maps are required (in glTF, Metallic and Roughness share one metallicRoughness texture).

rules.label: No animations, cameras or lights
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "Model should not contain modifiers, animation key frames, cameras or lights."

rules.label: Supported glTF extensions only
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "Unlisted glTF extensions are not currently supported."

rules.label: Floor alignment (Y-up, resting on Y=0, centred)
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": floor/tabletop models "must rest on the Y=0 plane, with all geometry extending into positive Y space" and are "centred at the base of the bottom surface in both the X and Z axes". Wall and ceiling products use different alignments, so this only warns.

rules.label: Double-sided materials
rules.sourceNote: Amazon "3D model technical requirements": "Double-sided textures are not supported." Shown as a warning because the exact meaning for glTF's doubleSided flag isn't spelled out.

rules.label: Maximum file size
rules.sourceNote: Third-party guides cite a 5 MB maximum for Amazon (e.g. https://blog.neural4d.com/image-to-3d/3d-product-rendering-for-ecommerce-amazon-glb-guide-2026/ and https://maverickframe.com/blog/3d-model-requirements-amazon-wayfair-shopify/, checked 2026-09-18), but Amazon's own "3D model technical requirements" page states no file size limit.
